features.title: Core Context API - PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md loading and validation
acceptance: FastAPI server starts and serves health endpoint
POST /context/load accepts project root and returns parsed PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md
Validates file existence and returns structured context
React frontend can call the API and display loaded context

features.title: Browser Extension - Copy All Issues (Issue #829)
acceptance: Extension popup has 'Copy all issues' button after scan
Copied output includes page URL, total findings, each issue's name/explanation/selector/guidance
Confirmation toast shown on successful copy

features.title: Design sidecar fingerprint validation (Issue #846)
acceptance: SHA-256 of DESIGN.md stored in sidecar on generation
Staleness check compares content fingerprint, not mtime
Legacy sidecars without fingerprint marked 'unverified' not 'stale'

features.title: Configurable PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md paths (Issue #1022)
acceptance: Shared resolver across context, live, and design tooling
Path validation with clear errors, backward compatible

features.title: Audit: flag physical CSS properties on RTL pages (Issue #1113)
acceptance: Informational on LTR pages, score rescales from /20 to /24
